newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Dec industrial output down 0.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Dec industrial output down 0.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Turkey's industrial production fell 0.2 percent in December from a year earlier, compared with a 5.5-percent rise in November, the State Institute of Statistics said on Wednesday.
It said the industrial output growth was 15.7 percent in the same 1995 month.
The mining industry shrank by 12 percent in December against a growth of 30.4 percent in December 1995, it said.
The manufacturing sector was also down by 0.4 percent in December, compared to 15.8 percent growth in the same 1995 month.
It said industrial production grew by 5.9 percent in the whole of 1996, down from 8.6 percent a year ago.
The mining sector grew by 3.8 percent in 1996 after only 0.1 percent growth in 1995 and manufacturing industry by 5.3 percent, down from nine percent.
